resources.string: Your actor isn\'t on this phone
You\'re signed in, but the key that acts as you lives elsewhere. Restore it with your recovery code to post, vouch, and act.
Your actor is back on this phone.
Membership completes when you point back. Choose your stance — it\'s your own signed act, and you can change it any time.
Your vouch is on its way onto the graph.
Signing didn\'t complete — check your connection and try again.
%1$d signed act(s) waiting to finish their handshake.
Locked until your inviter approves you
Inviting unlocks once your inviter approves you.
We emailed you a verification token. Paste it here to prove the address is yours.
That token is invalid or expired — resend and try the newest one.
If an application holds that address, a fresh token is on its way.
You can look around meanwhile — acting unlocks when you land. Close the app any time; we\'ll pick up right here.
Approved! Your Registration is signed and on its way onto the graph.
Something didn\'t verify on this phone, so nothing was signed. Try again from a fresh approval.
Your identity on the graph is a key minted on this phone. Create it now — your inviter can only approve you once it exists.
This phone\'s key belongs to another account
A signing key can only ever back one account, so this account needs its own. Creating a fresh key replaces the stored one — the other account\'s key stays restorable with its recovery code.
Your login is fine, but the application ran out before approval. Paste a fresh invite link to re-apply.
That doesn\'t contain an invite code.
This invite can\'t be used — ask your inviter for a new one.
You already have a live application.
Can\'t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Too many attempts — wait a moment and try again.
